items.text: Prompt share: Loose Watercolor Drift 💬 Prompt: Abstract watercolor wash of a [subject], loose oversized brushstrokes, broad flowing color shapes, minimal detail, soft pigment bleeding, expressive wet-on-wet texture, simplified forms, airy composition, no linework, no outlines, white background Try it and share yours ✨
